@@ -314,26 +314,18 @@ jobs:
           name: parser
           path: parser
 
-      # rewrite-flix is excluded from the build unless this jar is present -- the
-      # guard in settings.gradle.kts exists precisely so the module can be built
-      # against a locally supplied parser. Dropping the freshly built jar here is
-      # what makes the tests below exercise the artifact about to be published,
-      # rather than something merely similar to it.
-      - name: Supply the parser jar to rewrite-flix
-        env:
-          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.tag }}
-        run: |
-          set -euo pipefail
-          mkdir -p rewrite/rewrite-flix/libs
-          cp "parser/flix-parser-${RELEASE_TAG}.jar" rewrite/rewrite-flix/libs/flix-facade.jar
-          echo "supplied $(du -h rewrite/rewrite-flix/libs/flix-facade.jar | cut -f1) parser jar"
-
       # Install the parser under a real Maven coordinate so it travels in the
       # bundle. rewrite-flix builds against the file in libs/, which cannot reach
       # its published POM -- Gradle has no coordinate to write for a local file --
       # so a consumer would resolve rewrite-flix with no parser behind it and fail
       # at first parse. Publishing it here, and passing -PflixParserVersion below,
       # is what makes the bundle self-contained.
+      # -DgeneratePom=true is not optional. Without it install-file looks inside
+      # the jar for META-INF/maven/**/pom.xml and adopts the FIRST one it finds --
+      # and a shaded jar carries its bundled dependencies' POMs, so the parser
+      # would be installed under this coordinate carrying com.google.code.gson's
+      # descriptor, and every consumer would fail with "inconsistent module
+      # metadata".
       - name: Install the parser as a Maven artifact
         env:
           RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.tag }}
@@ -344,7 +336,8 @@ jobs:
             -DgroupId=org.openrewrite.vendor \
             -DartifactId=flix-parser \
             -Dversion="${RELEASE_TAG}" \
-            -Dpackaging=jar
+            -Dpackaging=jar \
+            -DgeneratePom=true
           test -f "$HOME/.m2/repository/org/openrewrite/vendor/flix-parser/${RELEASE_TAG}/flix-parser-${RELEASE_TAG}.jar"
 
       # The real consumability proof: rewrite-flix compiles against the jar and
